items.title: 28.5 Chromatography ki teen qismon ka muqabla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu comparison of the three types of chromatography (PDF 183).

blocks.caption: Chromatography ki teen qismon ka muqabla (kitab ka table)

blocks.text: Munasib stationary aur mobile phases chunna zaroori hai: alag karna tab hi kaam karta hai jab ajza is mein mukhtalif hon ke stationary phase unhein mobile phase ke muqable kitni mazbooti se thaamta hai. Maslan polar maadde alumina jaise polar stationary phase se mazbooti se thame jate hain, is liye kam polar solvent se unhein non-polar maaddon se alag kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Mixture mein har urne wale ester ka tanasub napne ke liye kaun si chromatography use karenge, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Gas chromatography: yeh urne wale compounds jaldi alag karti aur miqdari hai, kyunke peak areas har juzw ka tanasub dete hain.

items: Paper: partition, kaghaz mein paani, sust. TLC: adsorption, silica/alumina, tez. GC: gas-liquid partition, bohat tez aur miqdari.
